name: Hotel Bennett
positioning: Independent luxury hotel with European-inspired architecture on King Street in historic downtown Charleston, designed and owned by the local Bennett family, with a heated ninth-floor rooftop pool above Marion Square
best_for: Travelers who want to walk out onto King Street in historic downtown Charleston
Guests who want a rooftop pool and suites with views over Marion Square and the church steeples

facts.text: Hotel Bennett is in the center of historic downtown Charleston, and its doors open onto King Street.
The hotel's architecture is intricate and European-inspired.
The Bennett family, a local Charleston family, designed and owns the hotel.
The hotel stands on the site of the former Charleston County Library.
The heated rooftop pool is on the ninth floor above Marion Square, with panoramic views of downtown.
The rooftop pool is open year-round, exclusively to overnight guests.
Private rooftop cabanas can be reserved, with reserved chaise lounges, privacy curtains, refreshments and a complimentary bottle of Prosecco or six domestic beers.
The Spa at Hotel Bennett offers massages, facials and body treatments, including the Holy City Wrap.
The Fitness Room is on the second floor overlooking King Street and is open around the clock.
The King's Club offers a private lounge and terrace, and concierge service.
Fiat Lux is a rooftop bar and dining spot on the hotel's ninth floor with panoramic views of downtown Charleston.
Camellias is a champagne lounge inspired by Faberge jewels, with an etched-mirror ceiling and a crystal chandelier.

highlights.text: The top-floor Citadel Square Suite overlooks the Old Citadel, Marion Square and Charleston harbor.
The upper-floor St. Matthew's Suite sits beneath the steeple of historic St. Matthew's Lutheran Church.
The club-level Presidential Suite has a wrap-around terrace with views of the Ravenel Bridge, the Cooper and Ashley Rivers and the city skyline.
Camellias' bold pink interiors include marble reclaimed from the library that once stood on the site.
Hotel guests can book a private shopping experience at Gwynn's in Mount Pleasant, with roundtrip transportation, a private suite and a dedicated stylist.

considerations.text: Spa services are only for guests aged 18 and older.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms with two queen beds.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site parking in the downtown location.
